## 2. Architectural Case Studies & Flagship Projects

### Project 1: BMC Smart Civic Operating System (CityOS)
- **Problem Statement:** Municipal civic triage is notoriously plagued by duplicate citizen complaints, slow manual verification, and lack of geospatial routing across urban administrative wards.
- **Architectural Solution:**
  1. **Edge-to-Cloud CV Pipeline:** Citizen image uploads are processed via a fine-tuned YOLOv8 deep learning model trained across 6 municipal defect categories (potholes, overflowing garbage, illegal hoardings, open manholes, damaged streetlights, water pipeline leaks). The model delivers 91.4% mAP50 precision.
  2. **Compound Geospatial Deduplication:** MongoDB compound `2dsphere` indexes query active complaints within a dynamic 15-meter radial threshold. If an existing ticket exists with similar visual embeddings and matching coordinates, new submissions are merged into the existing ticket to prevent duplicate municipal dispatch.
  3. **High-Throughput Caching Layer:** Integrated Redis TTL caching and PM2 cluster management sustain 500+ requests/second at sub-50ms P95 latency.
- **Key Metrics:** 91.4% mAP50 • 500+ req/s P95 • <50ms query latency.
- **Links:**
  - Live System: https://smart-civic-pi.vercel.app
  - GitHub Repository: https://github.com/nikhilthange/smart-civic

### Project 2: HireMate — Autonomous AI Interview & Talent Intelligence
- **Problem Statement:** Candidate screening at scale suffers from latency in LLM generation, subjective interview evaluations, and high recruiter operational overhead.
- **Architectural Solution:**
  1. **Sub-300ms Token Streaming:** Engineered bi-directional WebSockets via Socket.IO linked to NVIDIA NIM microservice endpoints, streaming conversational interview questions with sub-300ms time-to-first-token.
  2. **Multi-Tenant RBAC:** Isolated corporate workspaces with strict Role-Based Access Control, audit logs, and encrypted candidate data persistence.
  3. **Rubric-Based ATS Match Engine:** Automated semantic comparison between candidate responses and job requirement rubrics, yielding an 88% rubric matching accuracy score.
- **Key Metrics:** <300ms token streaming • 88% ATS rubric match • Multi-tenant isolation.
- **Links:**
  - Live System: https://hiremate-portal.vercel.app
  - GitHub Repository: https://github.com/nikhilthange/ai-powered-interview-hiring-platform

### Project 3: SwasthyaSetu — Offline-First Rural Health Telemetry
- **Problem Statement:** Primary health clinics in rural and remote regions frequently face total cellular blackouts, rendering traditional cloud-only EHR/EMR systems unusable.
- **Architectural Solution:**
  1. **100% Offline Capability:** Implemented Dexie.js over browser IndexedDB with optimistic UI updates and local data encryption. Healthcare workers can record patient vitals, triage records, and clinical logs without active internet connection.
  2. **Two-Way Synchronization & Reconciliation:** When network connectivity is re-established, a conflict-free resolution engine synchronizes offline mutations with PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM.
  3. **Prescription OCR & GSM Fallback:** Incorporated TrOCR for handwriting prescription digitisation and GSM SMS fallback for emergency medical alerts.
- **Recognition:** Top 15 Finalist at MUSA Codex Hackathon.
- **Links:**
  - Live System: https://swastyasetu-three.vercel.app
  - GitHub Repository: https://github.com/aniketvishwakarma-11/Swastyasetu

### Project 4: CricNova AI — Telemetry & Predictive Analytics
- **Domain:** Real-Time Sports Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling
- **Tech Stack:** TypeScript, React 19, REST APIs, ML Models, Vite
- **Highlights:** Dynamic probability curves, live match telemetry ingest, responsive charts.
- **Links:**

### Project 5: SpeakLingo — Low-Latency WebRTC Audio Mesh
- **Domain:** P2P Audio Streaming & Speech Recognition
- **Tech Stack:** React 19, WebRTC, Socket.IO, Google STUN, Web Speech API
- **Highlights:** Sub-120ms audio latency, STUN signaling mesh, automated real-time captioning.

### Project 6: WhatsApp Group Extractor — Headless Automation
